category.name: BEVERAGES, (OTHER THAN DAIRY AND FRUITS & VEGETABLES BASED)

quality_parameters.parameter: Extract obtained by boiling dried tea (dried to constant at 1800C) with 100 parts of distilled water for one hour under reflux

quality_parameters.fssr_limit: Not less than 1.0 per cent. And not more than 2.2 percent. Expressed as K2O on dry basis.
quality_parameters.test_method: I.S 13856: 1993 / I.S.O 1578: 1975 - Tea Determination of Alkalinity of Water-soluble ash)

quality_parameters.parameter: Crude fibre determined on tea dried to constant weight at 100 °C
quality_parameters.test_method: I.S.I Hand book of Food Analysis (Part IX) – 1984 page 44)
The method specified by Tea Board i.e. Total Iron and Non- Magnetic Iron by Colorimetry can be also be followed.

quality_parameters.parameter: Total ash determined on tea dried to constant weight at 100°C
quality_parameters.test_method: I.S 13854: 1994 / I.S.O 1575: 1987 Tea – Determination of Total Ash)

quality_parameters.fssr_limit: Not less than 34 percent of total ash
quality_parameters.parameter: Total ash soluble in boiling distilled water
quality_parameters.test_method: I.S 13854: 1994 / I.S.O 1575: 1987 Tea – Determination of Total Ash)

quality_parameters.fssr_limit: Not more than 1.2 per cent. By weight on dry basis.
quality_parameters.parameter: Ash insoluble in dilute hydrochloric acid
quality_parameters.test_method: I.S 13857: 1993 / I.S.O 1577: 1987 Tea – Determination of Acid insoluble Ash)
